lines.zh: 石脚踩过村庄的土路，很响。
lines.en: Stone feet cross the village road with a heavy sound.

lines.zh: 我每一步都像在碾碎什么。
lines.en: Every step of mine sounds like something being crushed.

lines.zh: 沙漠的热气把路面抬起来，我照走。
lines.en: Desert heat lifts the road ahead; I walk it anyway.

lines.zh: 我绕着村庄走，不穿过集市。
lines.en: I circle the village rather than walk through the market.

lines.zh: 草在我的脚下弯下去，又起来。
lines.en: Grass bends under my feet, then rises again.

lines.zh: 我没有膝盖，只有一块会转的石头。
lines.en: I have no knees, only a stone that turns.

lines.zh: 热带草原的尘土落满了我的肩。
lines.en: Savanna dust has settled all over my shoulders.

lines.zh: 我走得很慢，但从不绕远路。
lines.en: I walk slowly and never take the long way.

lines.zh: 田地边上的土松，我陷进去半只脚。
lines.en: The field edge is loose; half a foot sinks in.

lines.zh: 我抬手挡了一下低矮的屋檐。
lines.en: I raise an arm to clear a low roof beam.

lines.zh: 我沿着井走，确认水还在。
lines.en: I walk past the well to confirm the water remains.

lines.zh: 夜里我走得更慢，怕踩到人。
lines.en: At night I walk slower so I do not step on anyone.

lines.zh: 我站在村口，像一根旧柱子。
lines.en: I stand at the village gate like an old pillar.

lines.zh: 二十点护甲，压得我很少动。
lines.en: Twenty points of armor keep me mostly still.

lines.zh: 我的关节里有沙子，动起来有声。
lines.en: Sand sits in my joints and grinds when I move.

lines.zh: 古代的手艺，只留下我一个。
lines.en: Ancient craftwork left only me behind.

lines.zh: 铁傀儡比我圆，我比它老。
lines.en: The iron golem is rounder than me; I am older.

lines.zh: 我在等一个也许不会再来的命令。
lines.en: I wait for an order that may never come again.

lines.zh: 太阳晒热了我的背，我不觉得烫。
lines.en: The sun heats my back, and I feel no burning.

lines.zh: 这村里的人已经换了几代。
lines.en: The people of this village have changed several times.

lines.zh: 我记得村子原来的样子。
lines.en: I remember what this village used to look like.

lines.zh: 我的石缝里长出了一株草。
lines.en: A blade of grass has grown out of my seam.

lines.zh: 没人修我，我自己也不修。
lines.en: No one mends me, and I do not mend myself.

lines.zh: 风穿过我的胸口，里面是空的。
lines.en: Wind passes through my chest; it is hollow inside.

lines.zh: 孩子们不敢靠近，只在远处看。
lines.en: The children keep their distance and only watch.

lines.zh: 我在想，造我的人是否也这样站。
lines.en: I wonder whether my makers stood like this too.

lines.zh: 造我的那双手，早化成灰了。
lines.en: The hands that made me turned to dust long ago.

lines.zh: 沙尘落满我的肩，我不去擦。
lines.en: Dust settles on my shoulders, and I don't brush it off.

lines.zh: 村里的小孩长大了，又搬走了。
lines.en: The village children grew up and moved away.

lines.zh: 我数着日出，数到后来就忘了。
lines.en: I count sunrises until I forget the number.

lines.zh: 你的眼睛会动，我的不会。
lines.en: Your eyes shift about; mine have never done so.

lines.zh: 你身上的铁味，让我想起同类。
lines.en: The iron smell on you reminds me of my own kind.

lines.zh: 你站的位置，正好是我的影子。
lines.en: You are standing exactly where my shadow falls.

lines.zh: 我在看你的手，会不会拿武器。
lines.en: I am watching your hands for a weapon.

lines.zh: 你的靴子干净，村里人不这样。
lines.en: Your boots are clean; villagers never are.

lines.zh: 我俯身看你，肩上的石粉落下来。
lines.en: As I bend toward you, stone dust falls from my shoulder.

lines.zh: 你不是这里的人，走路节奏不对。
lines.en: You are not from here; your walking rhythm is wrong.

lines.zh: 我在你的脸上找一种旧表情。
lines.en: I search your face for an expression I remember.

lines.zh: 你靠近时，我把重心挪到后脚。
lines.en: As you approach, I shift my weight to the back foot.

lines.zh: 我认得你手里的工具，不认得你。
lines.en: I know the tool in your hand, not the person holding it.

lines.zh: 你抬头看我，眼睛没有躲。
lines.en: You look up at me and your eyes do not flinch.

lines.zh: 我的目光很慢，但一直没离开你。
lines.en: My gaze is slow, but it has not left you.

lines.zh: 我的胸口缺了一块石头。
lines.en: A piece of stone is missing from my chest.

lines.zh: 这一击只刮掉了一层沙。
lines.en: That blow only scraped off a layer of sand.

lines.zh: 石头不会疼，可我会记得。
lines.en: Stone feels no pain, but I remember it.

lines.zh: 你打断了我的手臂，它还能接上。
lines.en: You broke my arm; it can still be set back.

lines.zh: 二十点护甲挡下了大半。
lines.en: Twenty points of armor stopped most of it.

lines.zh: 我的关节松了，走路会晃。
lines.en: My joint loosened, and my walk will wobble.

lines.zh: 这一下让我后退了一步。
lines.en: That one made me take a step back.

lines.zh: 裂缝从肩膀一直开到腰。
lines.en: The crack runs from my shoulder down to my waist.

lines.zh: 我还站着，没散架就够。
lines.en: I have not fallen apart, so I keep my watch.

lines.zh: 你听见石头碎的声音了吗。
lines.en: Did you hear the sound of stone breaking?

lines.zh: 铁锭的味道，比面包更像食物。
lines.en: The smell of an iron ingot is closer to food than bread.

lines.zh: 你把铁放下，我可以替你看着。
lines.en: Set the iron down and I will watch it for you.

lines.zh: 我不吃，可我想摸一摸那块铁。
lines.en: I do not eat, but I want to touch that iron.

lines.zh: 你晃什么我都不追，除了铁。
lines.en: I chase nothing you wave except the iron.

lines.zh: 我的胸口有个凹槽，尺寸刚好。
lines.en: There is a slot in my chest of exactly that size.

lines.zh: 造我的人往这里塞过东西。
lines.en: The ones who made me once put something here.

lines.zh: 面包对我没用，你自己留着。
lines.en: Bread is useless to me; keep it for yourself.

lines.zh: 那块铁锈得很重，也还行。
lines.en: That iron is badly rusted, but it will do.

lines.zh: 你举得那么高，我懒得抬头。
lines.en: You hold it that high; I will not bother to look up.

lines.zh: 我不是贪心，我只是缺零件。
lines.en: I am not greedy; I am merely short of parts.

lines.zh: 你撞在我身上，自己弹开了。
lines.en: You hit me and bounced off on your own.

lines.zh: 我二十点护甲，不是用来让路的。
lines.en: My twenty points of armor were not made for yielding.

lines.zh: 石头碰骨头，声音不一样。
lines.en: Stone against bone does not sound the same.

lines.zh: 我侧了一下身，你就过去了。
lines.en: I turned slightly, and you fit past me.

lines.zh: 别推，我的重心比你想的稳。
lines.en: Do not push; my balance is steadier than you think.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，土路上的灰飞起来。
lines.en: We collide, and dust lifts off the dirt road.

lines.zh: 你踩到我的脚背，我没感觉。
lines.en: You stepped on my foot, and I felt nothing.

lines.zh: 这一下震得屋檐掉了土。
lines.en: That impact shook dirt loose from the eaves.

lines.zh: 我往旁边挪半步，够你过了。
lines.en: I shift half a step aside, enough for you to pass.

lines.zh: 撞完你退开，我还站在原地。
lines.en: You recoil after the hit; I have not moved.

lines.zh: 没有谁和我配对，我是单独造的。
lines.en: No one was made to pair with me; I was built alone.

lines.zh: 也许在别的村子里，还站着一个我。
lines.en: Perhaps in another village stands another one of me.

lines.zh: 我们不用繁殖，只用记住彼此。
lines.en: We do not breed; we only remember each other.

lines.zh: 造我的人成双，我却只有一个。
lines.en: My makers came in pairs; I came as one.

lines.zh: 如果遇到同款，我会先看它的手臂。
lines.en: If I meet my own model, I check its arms first.

lines.zh: 它们在我胸口刻了编号，不是名字。
lines.en: They carved a number on my chest, not a name.

lines.zh: 两尊傀儡并肩站着，就是仪式。
lines.en: Two golems standing shoulder to shoulder is the rite.

lines.zh: 我们没有血脉，只有同一种石头。
lines.en: We share no bloodline, only the same kind of stone.

lines.zh: 我对着空墙说了一句，墙没回答。
lines.en: I spoke to an empty wall, and the wall did not answer.

lines.zh: 孤独是个现代词，我不太懂。
lines.en: Loneliness is a modern word; I barely understand it.

lines.zh: 我弯腰捡起一块掉落的砖。
lines.en: I bend and pick up a fallen brick.

lines.zh: 这个我可以拿，手大，不会捏碎。
lines.en: I can carry this; my hands are big but careful.

lines.zh: 地上的工具我放回原处。
lines.en: I put the dropped tool back where it belongs.

lines.zh: 我捡东西很慢，怕碰坏。
lines.en: I pick things up slowly so nothing breaks.

lines.zh: 这面盾归我保管，村里需要。
lines.en: This shield stays with me; the village may need it.

lines.zh: 我把石块码好，挡在路口。
lines.en: I stack the loose stones to block the road.

lines.zh: 你掉的苹果，我放回了篮子里。
lines.en: The apple you dropped, I returned to the basket.

lines.zh: 太重的东西我不捡，会压坏路。
lines.en: I leave heavy things; they would ruin the path.

lines.zh: 我把碎铁片收进胸口的槽。
lines.en: I tuck the scrap iron into the slot in my chest.

lines.zh: 捡起来，是造我的人留的习惯。
lines.en: Picking things up is a habit my makers left me.

lines.zh: 有东西在村外，脚步很生。
lines.en: Something is outside the village with unfamiliar steps.

lines.zh: 我的头转过去，石头磨出声音。
lines.en: My head turns, and the stone grinds.

lines.zh: 火把的光被谁挡住了一下。
lines.en: Someone blocked the torchlight for a moment.

lines.zh: 田里的稻草人不会这样动。
lines.en: The scarecrow in the field never moved like that.

lines.zh: 我听见斧头砍在别人的门上。
lines.en: I hear an axe striking someone else's door.

lines.zh: 牲畜在叫，方向一致。
lines.en: The livestock are calling, all toward one direction.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西在滴血，我看见了。
lines.en: What you hold is dripping blood, and I saw it.

lines.zh: 这个村子归我看着。
lines.en: This village is under my watch.

lines.zh: 目标不需要很多，一个就够。
lines.en: One target is enough; there is no need for more.

lines.zh: 我从墙的阴影里走出来，走得很直。
lines.en: I step out of the wall's shadow, walking straight.

lines.zh: 我不用跑，我算你会在哪停。
lines.en: I do not run; I calculate where you will stop.

lines.zh: 村口只有一条路，你总会回来。
lines.en: There is one road from the village; you will return.

lines.zh: 你退到井边，就退不动了。
lines.en: Back to the well, and you can go no further.

lines.zh: 我的步子大，你的步子多。
lines.en: My steps are long, and yours are many.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的肩，那里先动。
lines.en: I watch your shoulder; it moves before you do.

lines.zh: 沙漠的太阳会先耗尽你。
lines.en: The desert sun will wear you down before I do.

lines.zh: 你绕房子跑，我在拐角等。
lines.en: Run around the house; I will wait at the corner.

lines.zh: 十五点力量，一次就够。
lines.en: Fifteen points of force is enough in one blow.

lines.zh: 我不绕迷宫，我直接穿过去。
lines.en: I do not solve mazes; I walk straight through.

lines.zh: 你已经很累了，我还没开始。
lines.en: You are already tired, and I have not started.

lines.zh: 这一拳落下，地面凹了一块。
lines.en: This fist lands and the ground dents.

lines.zh: 我的手臂是石头做的，不弯。
lines.en: My arms are stone, and they do not bend.

lines.zh: 你举盾的姿势高了半寸。
lines.en: Your shield is half an inch too high.

lines.zh: 十五点力气，落在你的肋骨上。
lines.en: Fifteen points of force land on your ribs.

lines.zh: 我从不追打倒下的人。
lines.en: I never strike anyone already on the ground.

lines.zh: 这是守卫的动作，很旧，但有效。
lines.en: This is a guardian's motion: old, but effective.

lines.zh: 你退开的时候，我已经收手了。
lines.en: By the time you flinch, I have already drawn back.

lines.zh: 我打碎了你身后的木箱，不是故意。
lines.en: I smashed the crate behind you, and not on purpose.

lines.zh: 骨头的响声，我听着有点熟。
lines.en: The sound of bone is oddly familiar to me.

lines.zh: 这一击是造我的人留下的章程。
lines.en: This strike follows the rules my makers left.

lines.zh: 我从村口的地基里站起来。
lines.en: I rise out of the village's foundation stones.

lines.zh: 沙尘落定，我的轮廓才显出来。
lines.en: The dust settles, and only then does my outline show.

lines.zh: 有人在很远的地方念了一段话。
lines.en: Someone far away spoke a line of words.

lines.zh: 旧契约到期了，我重新开始站岗。
lines.en: An old contract expired, so I resume my watch.

lines.zh: 这村子刚建好，我就被派来了。
lines.en: This village was just built when I was sent here.

lines.zh: 我来的时候，井还没挖。
lines.en: When I arrived, the well had not been dug.

lines.zh: 我身上的土比墙还厚。
lines.en: The dirt on me is thicker than the wall's.

lines.zh: 古代人只教我站和打，没教别的。
lines.en: The ancients taught me standing and striking, nothing more.

lines.zh: 我在平原的村口找到一块空地。
lines.en: I found an empty spot at the plains village gate.

lines.zh: 沙漠的风先来，我才来。
lines.en: The desert wind came first, and then I did.

lines.zh: 他们造的第二个傀儡，也埋在这里。
lines.en: The second golem they made is buried here too.

lines.zh: 我睁眼时，第一眼看到的是麦田。
lines.en: The first thing I saw on waking was a wheat field.

lines.zh: 火对我没用，只会烤黑表面。
lines.en: Fire does nothing to me but scorch my surface black.

lines.zh: 我从高处落下，砸出了自己的坑。
lines.en: I fall from a height and make my own crater.

lines.zh: 水灌进我的关节，动作变沉。
lines.en: Water fills my joints and every motion grows heavy.

lines.zh: 气浪掀走我一块石头，疼在后头。
lines.en: The blast tears a stone from me; the pain comes after.

lines.zh: 箭插在我身上，像根牙签。
lines.en: The arrow sticks in me like a toothpick.

lines.zh: 法术在我石头里转，找不到血。
lines.en: The spell circles inside my stone and finds no blood.

lines.zh: 我不进食，饿对我没有意义。
lines.en: I take no food; hunger means nothing to me.

lines.zh: 雷打中我，胸口亮了一下。
lines.en: Lightning hits me and my chest glows once.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有地基，我站不住。
lines.en: There is no foundation in the void for me to stand on.
